headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: ChiNext index fell nearly 1% at midday, with agriculture and consumer stocks bucking the trend. Hang Seng Index fell 1% at midday, Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.76%, MINIMAX rose over 6%, Alibaba fell over 3%. Global bond yields climbed, with Japan's 10-year government bond yield rising to 3% for the first time since September 1996, US 5-year and 10-year Treasury yields hitting new highs since early 2025, and Australia's 10-year bond yield reaching a record high since 2011. China's August RatingDog manufacturing PMI rose to 51.5, a two-month high, with export new orders growing at the fastest pace in six months and factory-gate prices declining for the first time this year. Japan's finance minister said US-Japan joint forex intervention would be beneficial, downplaying reports that US Treasury Secretary Bessent urged the Bank of Japan to hike rates. South Korean presidential office policy chief Kim Yong-beom resigned; he had previously supported leveraged exposure to single stocks E

headlines.title: 澳大利亚楼市繁荣出现裂痕 悉尼房价自2月触顶以来下跌约7%
headlines.summary: 过去30年，在悉尼买房一直被视为澳大利亚最稳妥的投资之一。如今，澳大利亚楼市繁荣正在出现裂痕，并且影响开始向金融体系蔓延。随着贷款利率上升，加上澳大利亚政府预算案收紧投资房税收优惠政策，房价下跌正在澳大利亚全国蔓延。房地产咨询公司Cotality最新数据显示，悉尼房价自2月触顶以来已下跌约7%，各首府城市有93%的郊区房价出现下跌。

headlines.title_en: Cracks appear in Australia's property boom as Sydney prices fall about 7% from February peak
headlines.summary_en: Over the past 30 years, buying a home in Sydney has been seen as one of Australia's safest investments. Now, cracks are appearing in Australia's property boom, and the impact is spreading to the financial system. With rising mortgage rates and the Australian government's budget tightening tax incentives for investment properties, home prices are falling across the country. Latest data from property consultancy Cotality shows Sydney prices have fallen about 7% since peaking in February, with 93% of suburbs in major capital cities seeing price declines.

headlines.title: 瑞银：当前可以重新买入科技股 相比港股更看好A股
headlines.summary: 瑞银中国股票策略研究主管王宗豪在周二的媒体会上表示，当前可以重新买入科技股，同时考虑到资金面等因素，相比港股更看好A股。相较港股IPO和配售较多，A股资金面相对比较充裕，同时更看好硬件股，A股这类股票也占比较多。由于哑铃配置，亦看好银行股，并推荐与AI关联度没有那么高的有色板块，以及出海主题。对消费比较谨慎，增量政策可能更针对投资。持续看好美股科技股，对于标普500指数的年底目标位在8100点。

headlines.title_en: UBS: Time to buy tech stocks again; prefer A-shares over Hong Kong stocks
headlines.summary_en: UBS China equity strategy research head Wang Zonghao said at a Tuesday media briefing that it is time to buy tech stocks again, and given factors such as capital flows, prefers A-shares over Hong Kong stocks. Compared with more IPOs and placements in Hong Kong, A-share liquidity is relatively ample; he also prefers hardware stocks, which have a larger presence in A-shares. Due to barbell positioning, he also favors bank stocks and recommends non-ferrous metals sectors less correlated with AI, as well as going-global themes. He remains cautious on consumption, noting incremental policies may target investment more. He continues to like US tech stocks, with a year-end target of 8,100 for the S&P 500.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月工厂活动有所改善，但连续第二个月处于收缩区间，因订单回升未能完全抵消整体内需疲软和极端天气干扰的影响。数据显示，8月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.8，高于7月的49.2。

headlines.title: 杭州：支持前沿赛道未盈利的科创企业用好科创板、创业板改革政策，实现资本市场上市
headlines.summary: 《杭州市金融业发展“十五五”规划（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见。其中提到，深化科创金融改革试验区建设，健全“投贷补担保”科技金融体系。用好金融政策积极服务“千项万亿”工程项目，支持“两重”建设、“六张网”建设融资需求，构建投资于物与投资于人相结合的金融服务新模式。打造资本市场科技金融实践样本，构建首个、首批示范性案例的发现机制。把握投融资综合改革‌机遇，实施“凤凰行动”计划，引导科技型企业上市，支持企业用好境内外两个市场、两种资源，支持前沿赛道未盈利的科创企业用好科创板、创业板改革政策，实现境内资本市场上市。

headlines.title_en: Hangzhou: Support unprofitable sci-tech firms on frontier tracks in leveraging STAR Market and ChiNext reform policies to achieve capital market listings
headlines.summary_en: Hangzhou's '15th Five-Year Plan for Financial Industry Development (Draft for Comments)' is now open for public feedback. It proposes deepening the sci-tech finance reform pilot zone, improving the 'investment-loan-subsidy-guarantee' sci-tech financial system. It aims to use financial policies to serve 'thousand projects, trillion yuan' engineering projects, support financing needs for 'two major' construction and 'six networks' development, and build a new financial service model combining investment in things and investment in people. It seeks to create a capital market sci-tech finance practice model and establish a mechanism for discovering first and pilot demonstration cases. Seizing opportunities from comprehensive investment and financing reforms, it plans to implement the 'Phoenix Action' plan, guide tech enterprises to list, support companies in leveraging both domestic and overseas markets and resources, and help unprofitable sci-tech firms on frontier tracks use STAR Market and ChiNext reform policies to achieve listings on domestic capital markets.

headlines.title: 投资收益超3900亿元 全国社保基金2025年年报发布
headlines.summary: 9月1日，全国社会保障基金理事会发布的2025年度报告显示，2025年，全国社会保障基金投资收益额为3906.72亿元，投资收益率为13.22%。基金自成立以来的年均投资收益率为7.62%，累计投资收益额为22916.79亿元。

headlines.title_en: Investment returns exceed 390 billion yuan; National Social Security Fund releases 2025 annual report
headlines.summary_en: On September 1, the National Council for Social Security Fund released its 2025 annual report, showing that in 2025, the national social security fund investment gains reached 390.672 billion yuan, an investment return of 13.22%. The fund's average annual investment return since inception is 7.62%, with cumulative investment gains of 2,291.679 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 瑞银房东明：A股正在进入修复和重估的新阶段
headlines.summary: 第23届瑞银证券中国A股研讨会上，瑞银全球金融市场部中国主管房东明表示，相信在风险逐步释放、政策预期改善和盈利趋势向好的共同作用下，A股市场正在进入修复和重估的新阶段。他指出，从宏观层面看，下半年更多增量政策措施的落地值得期待，人工智能等战略科技密切相关的领域以及消费、地产等传统行业也都期望获得更多政策支持。创新与高端制造正在继续重塑着中国的外贸叙事。AI产业链已经成为中国进出口增长的重要驱动力。他认为，凭借有针对性的研发投入、模型架构创新以及开源协作，中国AI产业链正在以更具竞争力的成本效率重塑全球AI竞争格局。

headlines.title_en: UBS's房东明: A-shares entering new phase of repair and revaluation
headlines.summary_en: At the 23rd UBS Securities China A-share Seminar, UBS Global Financial Markets China head Fang Dongming said that with risks gradually being released, policy expectations improving, and earnings trends turning favorable, the A-share market is entering a new phase of repair and re-rating. He noted that from a macro perspective, more incremental policy measures are expected to land in the second half of the year, with areas closely tied to strategic tech like AI, as well as traditional sectors such as consumption and real estate, all hoping for more policy support. Innovation and advanced manufacturing are reshaping China's trade narrative, and the AI supply chain has become a key driver of China's import and export growth. He believes that with targeted R&D investment, model architecture innovation, and open-source collaboration, China's AI supply chain is reshaping the global AI competitive landscape with more competitive cost efficiency.

headlines.title: 1—7月我国软件业务收入同比增长9.2%
headlines.summary: 记者从工业和信息化部了解到，2026年前7个月，我国软件和信息技术服务业运行态势良好，软件业务收入稳健增长，利润总额增势平稳，软件业务出口保持正增长。今年前7个月，我国软件业务收入89785亿元，同比增长9.2%；软件业利润总额超过万亿元，同比增长1.3%。软件业务出口406.1亿美元，同比增长12.2%。分领域运行情况显示，软件产品收入稳定增长。前7个月，软件产品收入占全行业收入比重为21.6%。信息技术服务收入继续保持两位数增长。今年1—7月，信息技术服务收入同比增长10%，占全行业收入的68.7%。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China's software business revenue up 9.2% year-on-year in Jan-Jul
headlines.summary_en: The reporter learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that in the first seven months of 2026, China's software and information technology services industry performed well, with steady growth in software business revenue, stable profit growth, and positive growth in software business exports. In the first seven months of this year, China's software business revenue reached 8.9785 trillion yuan, up 9.2% year-on-year; total software industry profits exceeded 1 trillion yuan, up 1.3% year-on-year. Software business exports reached $40.61 billion, up 12.2% year-on-year. By segment, software product revenue grew steadily, accounting for 21.6% of total industry revenue in the first seven months. Information technology services revenue continued double-digit growth, up 10% year-on-year from January to July, accounting for 68.7% of industry revenue. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: CISA: July steel exports 10.121 million tons, down 1.9% month-on-month
headlines.summary_en: The China Iron and Steel Association released the July 2026 steel product import and export monthly report. In July, China exported 10.121 million tons of steel, down 1.9% month-on-month and up 2.9% year-on-year; the average export price was $715.7 per ton, up 0.7% month-on-month and 1.9% year-on-year. From January to July, cumulative steel exports were 64.995 million tons, down 4.4% year-on-year; the average export price was $703.4 per ton, up 0.6% year-on-year. In July, steel imports were 445,000 tons, up 0.9% month-on-month and down 1.7% year-on-year; the average import price was $1,952.4 per ton, up 1.4% month-on-month and 8.2% year-on-year. From January to July, cumulative steel imports were 3.14 million tons, down 10.1% year-on-year; the average import price was $1,818.9 per ton, up 5.8% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 《深圳经济特区促进脑机接口产业创新发展若干规定》公开征求意见
headlines.summary: 其中提到，市人民政府应当将脑机接口产业发展纳入本市国民经济和社会发展规划和科技创新专项规划，建立健全促进脑机接口产业发展的议事协调机制，统筹协调脑机接口技术创新、产业发展、行业应用、安全治理等方面的重要事项。市人民政府应当保障脑机接口基础研究领域的持续投入，支持各类创新主体开展脑机接口前沿交叉基础研究。市科技创新部门应当聚焦脑机接口产业关键核心环节，以工业制造、医疗健康、生活消费等方面需求为导向，支持企业联合高等院校、科研机构、医疗机构等组建创新联合体，开展脑机接口核心技术攻关，加快脑机接口产品应用落地。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone regulations to promote innovative development of brain-computer interface industry open for public comment
headlines.summary_en: It mentions that the municipal government should incorporate the brain-computer interface industry into the city's national economic and social development plan and special plans for sci-tech innovation, establish and improve coordination mechanisms to promote the industry's development, and coordinate matters related to technological innovation, industry growth, applications, and safety governance. The municipal government should ensure sustained investment in basic research for brain-computer interfaces and support various innovation entities in frontier interdisciplinary basic research. The municipal sci-tech innovation department should focus on key core segments of the BCI industry, oriented toward industrial manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer needs, support enterprises in forming innovation consortia with universities, research institutes, and medical institutions to tackle core BCI technologies and accelerate product deployment.

headlines.title: 宁德时代年内债券发行规模超历年总和

headlines.title_en: CATL's bond issuance this year exceeds total of all previous years
headlines.summary_en: CATL completed a new tranche of medium-term notes last week, pushing its bond financing this year past 40 billion yuan, exceeding the total bond issuance in all prior years. Data shows CATL's net new interest-bearing debt in the first half was about 29.4 billion yuan, with nearly 90% of the increase coming from bond financing. While total interest-bearing debt continues to expand, interest expenses in the first half fell over 10% year-on-year, reflecting efforts to lower financing costs through increased bond financing and optimized debt structure.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: ChiNext index fluctuates lower by 0.92%, grain concept stocks surge across the board
headlines.summary_en: As of midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.03%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.58%, the ChiNext Index fell 0.92%, and the Beijing Stock Exchange 50 rose 1.18%. Total turnover across the three markets reached 1.3612 trillion yuan, up 40.5 billion yuan from the previous day. More than 3,500 stocks rose across the market. By sector, food concepts, dairy, and short-drama games led gains, while electronic chemicals and components lagged. In trading, food concepts surged broadly, with Wandong Denong hitting a six-day limit-up and Xinsai Shares a four-day limit-up. Xinhua Department Store, Jingliang Holdings, Dunhuang Seed, Longping High-Tech, Gongxiao Daji, Shenzhen Cereals Holdings, Jinjian Rice, Nongfa Seed, Shennong Seed, and Denghai Seed all hit limit-up. Kangnong Seed rose over 15%, while Qiule Seed and Lyheng Technology gained over 10%.
